question: When deriving duplicate-adjusted language votes and the four subject nominations from 256 predictions without heading, should two hypotheses for one object share its missing heading?
method: Only change the overlap matrix in v1 subject nomination and its explicit prior. For each pair of intrinsic length/width/height boxes, take the Jaccard index of occupied (3D point, common axial heading) sets, using uniform heading. Expected parallel-rectangle intersection divided by expected union is integrated exactly within each angle segment. Original weights, original PCA per candidate, four subjects, four factual references, decoder and all 256 original box geometries are retained.
controls: Measured PCA uses each proposal's actual final yaw. Disk uses equal footprint area with exact cylinder intersection. Crossed axes assigns a quarter turn to the second footprint relative to the first and integrates the same uniform bearing, preserving both absolute orientation marginals; it is a mismatched coupling, not independent continuous orientations. Vote-only changes the density correction and utility while keeping the old overlap test for diversity. Diversity-only changes that test while preserving the full original utility. Axis-45 uses original formula relative to rotated horizontal coordinates. All preserve equal native IDs and degenerate singleton convention.
unit_tests: Compare analytic lifted overlap against direct quadrature of rectangle intersections and the PCA arm against an independent oriented IoU implementation. Verify coordinate rotation and translation invariance of the lifted and disk kernels. Check v1 nominees, priors, and winners versus the live pipeline and archived slates before scoring. Rotation invariance applies to the nomination kernel conditional on fixed native proposals and their probabilities, not the backbone or full system.
populations: 384 source recording holdout and 3072 previously exposed ordinary TRAIN directional records, including all fallbacks. Primary is six-direction macro strict Acc50, secondary Acc25 and mIoU, report absolute and paired scores, slate recall, outside-four rescues/harms, recording uncertainty and timings. If shared heading exceeds v1, measured PCA, crossed axes and equal-area disk on pilot Acc50 and produces net outside-four rescues, run the frozen method and all controls on ordinary Validation 18620. The three source models are not trained or calibrated in this study, and monitoring source/target scores does not change the function. Do not promote a claim when rotation invariance holds but task benefit does not.
comparison: Compute actual oriented IoU with the original seven-field GT only after choices and slates for a stage are sealed. The original-v1 reference pool and role features are shared across all arms. Additional analysis pairs outside-slot rescue rates with absolute counts and measures retained/gained/lost attainable candidates. Raw GT, raw captions, coordinates, camera and scene identifiers stay private.
